standard-dialogue-during-the-dwarves-vis.player: Hello. What's happening in town at the moment?

standard-dialogue-during-the-dwarves-vis.npc: These dwarves have arrived from Keldagrim - the Chancellor has asked me to look after them, but they are eating all of our food and drinking all of our booze.

standard-dialogue-during-the-dwarves-vis.player: What are the dwarves doing here?

standard-dialogue-during-the-dwarves-vis.npc: They are organising some sort of trade agreement. I don't know what they are trading.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-the-f.text: If the player has not yet talked to Vanligga:

steps.npc: Oh, hello [Fremennik name]. Always good to see a friend.
Hmmm, I suppose I can trust you, since you have done me a favour in the past. Can you keep a secret?
Well as you probably already know, all yak meat and yak products are banned on this island - orders of the King...

steps.player: That King has some very strange attitudes.

steps.npc: Well, I have a contact on the other island. Are you interested in obtaining some produce?
Well, any time you need black market yak produce, you know where to come.
